import sys

from harness import *

ok = True
def A0(frames, t=1, level="A"):
    return [key(0,"A","install"), dg(t,1200,[pkt(level,0,True,frames)])]
def I0(frames, t=0):
    return [dg(t,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,frames)])]

# ---- ACK frame encoding errors (I space, sent covers everything)
FULL = {"I":[[0,4611686018427387903]],"H":[],"A":[]}
for name, ranges in [
    ("ack empty", []),
    ("ack reversed", [[5,3]]),
    ("ack adjacent", [[0,1],[2,3]]),
    ("ack overlapping", [[0,5],[3,9]]),
    ("ack unsorted", [[10,20],[0,5]]),
    ("ack dup", [[0,5],[0,5]]),
    ("ack nested", [[0,10],[2,3]]),
    ("ack touching", [[0,5],[6,7]]),
]:
    ok &= check(name, CFG(sent=FULL), I0([ACK(*ranges)]),
        RES("t",[pres(0,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,0)],
            conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",0,src(0,0,0)), KEYS(), 0, [],
            [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

    ("cov gap", [[0,4],[10,14]], None),
